response.text: One paid invoice doesn't match its payments. I'll look at that one and check the period/date conventions and the GL journal that the AP invoice posts to.

arguments.sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."JRNL_NO", COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) AS paid, COUNT(p."PAY_ID") AS npay FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."JRNL_NO" HAVING i."STAT_CD"='P' AND COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0)<>i."INV_AMT" UNION ALL SELECT 0, 0, 'PRD', MIN("PRD_ID"), MAX("PRD_ID")::numeric, COUNT(*) FROM "GLPERD" UNION ALL SELECT 0, 0, 'PERIOD_SAMPLE', "PRD_ID", "STRT_DT"::numeric, "END_DT"::numeric FROM "GLPERD" WHERE "PRD_ID" IN (1,8);
SELECT a."ACCT_CD", a."ACCT_NM", a."ACCT_TYP", SUM(l."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS cr, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLCOA" a ON a."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1;
